name: Match starter
design: Compact athletic adult female with deep red-brown speckled hide, narrow uncovered skull, blunt four mandibles, medium dreadlocks tied in short nape fan. Short mustard official tunic with broad charcoal side panels, fitted cloth trousers, wrapped calves and leather bracers. Holds two small paired wooden-metal signal clappers down by thighs, no firearms; one foot a little forward in alert relaxed stance.
